title: Baked terrain region meta.json: the farm-type geometry
description: F2-19 (docs/FARM_TYPES_SPEC.md section 4): a baked real region (G2-01) names its land pads and offshore slots here, the single geometric source for the site-plot catalogue (ISitePlotGeometry) in place of the procedural layout (TerrainGenerator.LandPadSlots / OffshoreSlots). World metres in the terrain's frame (X and Z horizontal, the sea level at y = 0). Field names are the snake_case of LandPadSlot and OffshoreSlot (src/LakskongenSim/Environment/SitePlotGeometry.cs). A pad's intake reach is computed from the terrain (TerrainGenerator.IntakeReachM), never authored, so the field is not allowed. The bake's other keys (G2-01) are outside this schema.

land_pads.description: The land pads in catalogue order (site_plots.json's land pads by id).

offshore_slots.description: The offshore slots in catalogue order.

land_pad.description: A flat shore pad, an axis-aligned rectangle round its centre carved to pad_height_m, its quay on the side that faces the channel.

lots.description: Grow-out lots the pad holds (spec section 5.1).

pad_height_m.description: The plan level above the sea (3.6 +- 0.3 m, the F2-19 tolerance).

quay_x.description: The quay's point on the pad's water-facing edge.

offshore_slot.description: An open-sea slot outside the play area's water bake.

exposure.description: Open-sea exposure at the slot (1 outside the bake).
